min_range_km.description: Minimum orthogonal separation distance between objects at TCA

rel_vel_km_s.description: Relative velocity magnitude at closest approach instant

momentum_transfer_potential.description: Proxy for destructive momentum concentration: rel_vel / max(min_range, 0.005)

lead_time_days.description: Primary spacecraft propagation horizon from TLE epoch to TCA

secondary_lead_time_days.description: Secondary object propagation horizon from TLE epoch to TCA

lead_time_diff_days.description: Absolute divergence between primary and secondary observation epochs

max_propagation_horizon_days.description: Maximum propagation duration (indicates TLE covariance ellipsoid error growth)

inclination_diff_deg.description: Absolute difference in orbital inclination between planes

altitude_1_km.description: Primary spacecraft mean orbital altitude above WGS-84 reference

altitude_2_km.description: Secondary object mean orbital altitude above WGS-84 reference

altitude_diff_km.description: Absolute difference in mean orbital altitude

eccentricity_max.description: Maximum orbital eccentricity between the two objects

period_diff_min.description: Absolute difference in orbital revolution period

is_debris_encounter.description: Binary flag indicating whether one or both objects are non-maneuverable debris

is_indian_spacecraft.description: Binary flag indicating whether the conjunction involves a monitored ISRO asset
